cases.title: Vendor-themed Okta vishing wave
cases.notes:
WORKING THEORY
Waves of <vendor>-okta / -servicenow domains since late July support live vishing: the caller sends the target to the look-alike SSO page and talks them through a fallback MFA method.

OPEN
- any of the 13 domains resolving / serving a page today?
- registrar + nameserver overlap between waves
- which of our vendors appear in the pattern

SOURCES
- Dataminr TRACE brief, 19 Oct 2026
- Okta reporting on MFA enrolment weaknesses (referenced by the brief)

items.title: English-speaking cybercrime crew (unnamed)
items.body: Dataminr links the domains with high confidence to earlier English-language cybercrime activity with the same targeting. No group name published. Tradecraft: vendor-themed SSO lures + live vishing + MFA downgrade.

items.title: B2B e-commerce SaaS & infrastructure providers
items.body: Marketing / customer-engagement platforms, logistics partners, payment and fraud-prevention providers. Several hit more than once. Likely chosen for downstream third-party breach leverage.
items.impact: Credentials + MFA bypass → SSO access; data-extortion leverage over the providers' customers

items.title: Vishing calls using the look-alike SSO pages
items.body: September 2026: targeting pattern against e-commerce SaaS providers observed. Callers direct users to the fake Okta page and talk them into a fallback MFA method.

items.title: Case plan
items.body: Opening tasks for this playbook. Tick them off in the inspector.

items.title: Dataminr TRACE brief — Okta-themed phishing targets e-commerce providers
items.body: Published 19 Oct 2026. Waves of look-alike Okta / ServiceNow domains since late July 2026; September targeting pattern against e-commerce SaaS and infrastructure providers. Domains support vishing calls that walk users through an MFA downgrade (SMS / email code) to get past YubiKeys.

todo.text: Block all 13 domains at proxy + mail gateway
Search SSO logs for logins from VPN/proxy IPs + MFA enrolment changes
Registrar abuse report for the -okta / -servicenow domains

comments.text: Registered 18 Oct, flagged by TRACE within a day. Treat as live until the registrar confirms suspension.

items.title: First wave of look-alike domain registrations

items.body: MFA downgrade: where policy allows SMS or email codes as fallback, the caller gets the user to enrol or use one, bypassing the YubiKey.
Naming pattern: <vendor>-okta[.]com, okta<vendor>[.]com, <vendor>-servicenow[.]com, servicenow-ticket<n>[.]com. Monitor new registrations matching it.

judgement.text: We assess with moderate confidence that an English-speaking cybercrime crew is running a vendor-themed Okta / ServiceNow vishing campaign against B2B e-commerce SaaS providers, using look-alike SSO pages to drive an MFA downgrade past hardware keys. Motive is most likely data-extortion leverage over the providers' downstream customers.
judgement.dissent: State-directed collection is not excluded: the same kit and call centre could serve an espionage tasking. Victimology outside e-commerce, or attribution of the voice operators, would change the call.
